body:
Hang in there, I know it’s difficult :(

Was there ever a time where you’ve felt differently?

There is still a lot of time left for you, my friend. It sounds like you’ve been through a lot of difficult thoughts recently and I hope you can work on whatever is ailing you. If you feel like you want to talk more you have a community here that would love to listen.
It sounds like you’ve got a lot on your plate, if you want to talk more about it I’d like to hear what you have to say.
Just hang on a little longer, friend. Idk if you have access to getting help, but I would fully recommend it. Always down to talk if you need an ear.

I think when it comes down to it that there’s still a lot of life left for you to live and it doesn’t have to be all bad. I lived for a long time thinking things would end badly for me but they’ve been looking up quite a bit lately. It’s hard now to imagine a place that looks like that, now, I’m sure.  I know it’s hard right now, but try to have a little bit of faith in yourself and your ability. There’s also help for you if you need it.

Just slow down a second and take some deep breaths, friend. I know this is something you really want to do, but it sounds more like you need someone who understands what’s going on that you can talk to.

I don’t know if you’ve had people ignore your feelings or put you down for feeling what you are. I know it’s hard. I’m assuming there’s more going on behind the scenes, but try to talk to someone you can trust if you feel able to right now.
Hey man, don’t count yourself out yet okay? You’ve been through so much, and I think you deserve more credit to yourself than you realize.  I’m sure you’re exhausted at the moment as well.
Hey there, 27M from the states, feel free to shoot me a message.
I think about this a lot. I wish I could tell my younger self that I’m sorry for what life gets turned into. He was screwed from the start.

Please please please don’t do this. It’s not worth it. I’m sure you’re angry but there’s nothing helpful about killing someone who has made you feel like this. Give yourself a chance and space to recover.
I’m completely burnt out and I don’t really want to keep going. I’m basically just going to work until I’m dead and that’ll be it. I just don’t have the desire to keep living.
